item.title: VCU defeats George Mason 70-65
item.description: Terrence Hill Jr. led VCU past George Mason on Tuesday night with 16 points off of the bench in a 70-65 victory.

item.title: Dayton defeats Richmond 65-60
item.description: Deshayne Montgomery led Dayton with 15 points and Jordan Derkack secured the victory on a jump shot with 39 seconds remaining as the Flyers took down Richmond 65-60 on Tuesday.

item.title: No. 13 Virginia wraps up No. 2 seed in ACC with 75-70 win over Wake Forest
item.description: Thijs De Ridder scored 16 points and No. 13 Virginia outlasted Wake Forest 75-70 on Tuesday night to secure the No. 2 seed and a double-bye in the Atlantic Coast Conference Tournament.
